Creating a second role for the same contact raises DUPLICATE_VALUE and rolls back the entire renewal opportunity insert, silently. Only create when no role exists for this contact.

Flow.description: This flow updates the fields of triggering record, record can be new or existing. Most generic fields are updated in this flow. Same-record Opportunity updates are accumulated in memory on the recordId variable and committed once (Commit Opportunity Updates) to minimise DML.

formulas.name: Forecast_status
formulas.expression: if(text({!recordId.Owner.Team__c})='Lexology Pro' || text({!recordId.Owner.Team__c})='Specialist Platforms' || text({!recordId.Owner.Team__c})='Lexology Intelligence' ,'Forecast Pending','Forecast Won')

formulas.name: forecastvalue
formulas.expression: CASE({!recordId.Type}, "New Business", "New Business", "Auto-Renewal", "Renewal", "Auto-Repeat Business", "Renewal", "Renewal", "Renewal", "Repeat Business", "Renewal", "Upsell", "Upsell", "Downgrade", "Downgrade", "Cancellation", "Cancellation", null)

Flow.label: Opportunity_AL_FieldUpdates (OCR guard)
